queries: Alphabet first quarter 2026 results Google Cloud operating income
NVIDIA first quarter fiscal 2027 results net income data center revenue

sources_considered.why: Alphabet Q1 2026 release. Google Cloud operating income and growth attributed to enterprise AI.
Republished NVIDIA press release for Q1 FY27 (quarter ended April 26, 2026).
Secondary analysis. The primary release was used instead.

evidence_items.locator: Opening bullet points, Google Cloud bullet

receipt.public_excerpt: Google Cloud saw a meaningful acceleration in growth as revenues increased 63% to $20.0 billion, led by an increase in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI Solutions and enterprise AI Infrastructure

evidence_items.explanation: Alphabet attributes Google Cloud's Q1 2026 growth mainly to enterprise AI solutions and AI infrastructure. This links the segment's profit (e2) to AI.

evidence_items.locator: Segment Results table, operating income (Q1 2025 vs Q1 2026, $ millions)
evidence_items.explanation: Google Cloud, run under Pichai and growing on AI demand, earned $6.6B of operating income in Q1 2026, up from $2.2B. That is actual profit from an AI-driven business in the period.

evidence_items.locator: Press release, paragraph 3 (after headline bullets: record revenue $81.6B, Data Center revenue $75.2B)

receipt.public_excerpt: For the quarter, GAAP and non-GAAP earnings per diluted share were $2.39 and $1.87, respectively.

evidence_items.explanation: NVIDIA, whose revenue is overwhelmingly AI data center sales ($75.2B of $81.6B), was solidly profitable in the quarter ended April 26, 2026. That is AI-industry profitability in the period.

unresolved_gaps: I cited no evidence on the losses of AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic, which would support a narrower reading limited to AI model companies.
Returns on hyperscaler AI capex are not separately reported.
